scope: Readability, accuracy and future coverage for the preceding GIF-good review

changes.problem: A packed PE inside an archive bypassed the NRV decoder and lost all decoded-backdoor findings.
changes.fix: Run bounded NRV2B-8 PE recovery for binary archive members, independently of the source-string extraction gate.
changes.proof: Before: three packed backdoors in ZIP members had no hostile findings. After: direct files, renamed ZIP/TAR members and nested archives retain backdoor findings, while benign NRV-compressed PE controls remain neutral.

changes.problem: A GIF parser abort was described as data after a completed container.
changes.fix: The engine reports bytes beyond parsed container regions; the trait uses the same factual wording and accepts the old fact spelling for deployed-engine compatibility.
changes.proof: The new unit test aborts GIF parsing before a trailer, verifies invalid structure, preserves PE stowaway detection and verifies the revised problem statement.

changes.problem: The loader repeatedly transforms fixed buffers before transferring into writable executable output; this behavior had no descriptive finding.
changes.fix: Add a suspicious timing-evasion observation requiring the counted loop, matching counter slots, internal executable call target, bounded input, matching output/transfer address and writable executable output section.
changes.proof: All three real loaders match. A changed large count still matches; a low count, mismatched counter, mismatched transfer buffer, non-executable output or out-of-code transform target does not. No hash, server, XOR key, exact payload size or family token gates this observation.
changes.interpretation: The observed repeated work before stage execution supports suspected analysis delay. This is suspicious, not a standalone hostile verdict.

changes.problem: Six API-reference observations were named like ordered execution chains or resolved calls.
changes.fix: Rename CryptoAPI and PSAPI observations as API profiles/references and update every live YAML consumer.
changes.proof: All six rules preserve matcher, scope, conditions and criticality after normalizing the ID changes. The new names are verified on direct and archived real samples.

changes.problem: Recovered executable findings used generic encoding jargon, and neutral XOR metadata inferred concealment.
changes.fix: State that a PE image was recovered from XOR/NRV encoding and describe validated repeating-XOR PE content without inferring intent. Improve the socket-buffer execution and MiniDuke vocabulary descriptions.

classification_effect: No classification changes; the four malicious local relocations remain intact. Hopper rulings from the preceding triage remain pending its full-validation gate.

These changes were preserved. The retained validator binary predates this improvement.

references.role: Primary ATT&CK reference includes computation-based execution delays; the rule interpretation remains explicitly suspicious.
